hotspots.title: Trump’s Wisconsin farm visit sparks outrage
hotspots.blurb: President Trump’s visit to Wisconsin to discuss agriculture policies with farmers has ignited a wave of protests and counter-protests. Local Democrats and activists criticized his policies, while supporters praised his efforts to support rural America.
hotspots.affect: This event commands disproportionate attention due to the polarized reactions it elicits, highlighting deep political divisions and the symbolic importance of rural America in Trump’s political narrative.

hotspots.title: Bullrich’s rebellion against Javier Milei
hotspots.blurb: Patricia Bullrich’s defiance of President Javier Milei over judicial appointments has escalated into a full-blown internal conflict within Argentina’s ruling party. The Senate’s approval of a controversial judge despite Milei’s opposition underscores Bullrich’s growing influence.
hotspots.affect: This ongoing feud captures attention due to its high-stakes implications for Argentina’s governance and the visible power struggle within the ruling coalition.

hotspots.title: AfD’s extremism classification in Hesse
hotspots.blurb: The Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) party faces renewed scrutiny after its extremism classification in Hesse. The party’s actions, including controversial statements and policies, have sparked widespread debate about its role in German politics.
hotspots.affect: This issue commands attention due to the moral and political implications of classifying a major political party as extremist, reflecting broader concerns about the rise of far-right politics in Europe.

hotspots.title: PP and Vox coalition talks intensify in Spain
hotspots.blurb: Negotiations between Spain’s Partido Popular (PP) and Vox have reached a critical juncture, with potential coalition governments forming in multiple regions. The agreements have sparked controversy over Vox’s far-right policies and their impact on governance.
hotspots.affect: This development is highly charged due to the ideological divide it exposes and the potential for Vox’s far-right policies to influence Spanish governance at a regional level.

hotspots.title: Hungary’s EU migration pact protests
hotspots.blurb: Mass protests erupted in Budapest against Hungary’s signing of the EU migration pact. Demonstrators, led by far-right figures, accused Prime Minister Péter Magyar of betrayal, while the government defended its decision as necessary for EU funding.
hotspots.affect: The protests are highly charged due to the emotional and political stakes surrounding immigration and national sovereignty, amplified by far-right rhetoric and government responses.
